description: 1986 is the Year of the Fire Tiger in the Chinese zodiac, from February 9, 1986 to January 28, 1987. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1986 is the Year of the Fire Tiger, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 9, 1986 and ended on January 28, 1987, so people born in 1986 before Feb 9 belong to the Wood Ox year.

sections.heading: 1986 Lunar New Year: start and end dates
paragraphs: Lunar New Year opened the Fire Tiger year on February 9, 1986, and the year ran to January 28, 1987. So a birth date of Feb 9, 1986 or later counts as Fire Tiger, and so do early 1987 birthdays through Jan 28; births in 1986 before Feb 9 still belong to the Wood Ox. That moving boundary comes from the lunisolar calendar, in which the new year starts with the second new moon after the winter solstice in most years, so its Gregorian date shifts by up to a month from one year to the next. Look sixty years either side and the pairing repeats: 1926 are Fire Tiger years too. That Sunday new year arrived with the Sun in Aquarius in the Western zodiac.

sections.heading: What the Fire Tiger is like
paragraphs: A Fire Tiger year brings together courage and blazing enthusiasm. Classical readings describe people born now as magnetic, daring and passionate, often first through any door that looks exciting. Because the Tiger's Wood kindles Fire directly, their vitality is abundant. Their growth, most interpretations suggest, lies in patience: sleeping on big decisions and listening to quieter voices before charging ahead.

Belonging to the south and to the height of summer, Fire brings brightness, drive and visibility to any sign it colours. Classical texts connect it with enthusiasm, leadership and the urge to be seen and to make an impression. A Fire stem tends to make an animal more expressive, more daring and more openly emotional than its usual reputation suggests. People born in Fire years are often described as inspiring company and natural motivators. The caution most readings attach is a short fuse and a difficulty with slow seasons, when steady effort matters more than spark and the reward is a long way off.

sections.heading: 1986 in the animal cycle and in numerology
paragraphs: In numerology the year's digits come to 6, linked with home, care and responsibility, so a 6 year is read as one centred on family and commitments. The digits of 1986 add up to 24, which reduces to 6. The Tiger holds the third place among the twelve animals and its fixed element is Wood. Set beside the year's Fire stem, wood generates Fire, which readings use to describe how settled or stretched the combination feels. The year before was the Wood Ox and the year after is the Fire Rabbit.

Chinese almanacs name 1986 Bing-Yin, pairing the Fire stem Bing with the branch Yin. Both are Yang, as stem and branch always share a polarity, so of the hundred and twenty possible pairings only sixty ever occur, and each one names a single year in every cycle.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1986?
faq.answer: 1986 is the Year of the Fire Tiger. It started on February 9, 1986 and ended on January 28, 1987.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1986?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 9. Born before February 9, 1986, you are a Wood Ox; born on or after it, you are a Fire Tiger.

faq.question: What element is 1986 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Fire, a Yang year. The Tiger's own fixed element is Wood; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1986?
faq.answer: Bing-Yin. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Fire Tiger year?
faq.answer: 2046, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1926.
